description: Largest-remainder rounding of subtask times to whole minutes (src/shared/work-log/rounding.ts and src-tauri/src/work_log/rounding.rs): each value is cut to its minute, and the minutes still missing to reach the target's minute go one each to the largest remainders (the first on a tie). Values and results in ms.

cases.name: two minutes to the largest remainders
a tie goes to the first
target with seconds keeps its whole minutes
values above the target lose from the smallest remainders, the last on a tie
